# `any_value`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
any_value(expr[, isIgnoreNull])
```

Returns some value of `expr` for a group of rows.
If `isIgnoreNull` is true, returns only non-null values.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- any_value, example 1
> SELECT any_value(col) FROM VALUES (10), (5), (20) AS tab(col);
10
```

```sql
-- any_value, example 2
> SELECT any_value(col) FROM VALUES (NULL), (5), (20) AS tab(col);
NULL
```

```sql
-- any_value, example 3
> SELECT any_value(col, true) FROM VALUES (NULL), (5), (20) AS tab(col);
5
```
